operate.title: In Operate
operate.hideHint: This agent’s conversations (all its instances) do not appear in Operate’s column. They come back up when the agent needs you. A Macro setting: it is not carried by the export.
operate.entryHintHelp: Helps whoever launches the system write their starting message. A Macro setting, not carried by the export.

views.label: System view

empty.tools: This system uses no tool server.

views.filesHint: Read only. To change an item, open its card or ask the Architect agent.

emptyHint.agents: An agent is a role given to a model: it reads, writes or checks. Add one, then place it in the flow.
emptyHint.skills: A skill is a set of instructions an agent can pick up when it needs it. Add one, then give it to an agent.
emptyHint.tools: A tool server gives agents access to a service, such as a code host or a knowledge base. Add one, then give it to an agent.

views.emptyReadOnly: This version is read-only. Adapt it to add or change items.

agent.title: New agent
agent.intro: The agent is added to the system but not to the flow yet: you decide where it takes part.
agent.advancedHelp: Read only is the safe start. You can change both later, from the agent’s card.
agent.done: Agent “{{name}}” added. It is not in the flow yet.

skill.title: New skill
skill.intro: A skill is written as a file of the project. An agent only uses it once you give it to them.
skill.done: Skill “{{name}}” added. Give it to an agent so it gets used.

tool.title: New tool server
tool.intro: An agent only reaches this server once you give it to them.

addressHelp.remote: The server must be reachable from the computer that runs the system.
addressHelp.local: A program followed by its arguments, separated by spaces. Macro checks it at launch.

tool.done: Tool server “{{name}}” added. Give it to an agent so it gets used.

add.notSaved: The draft was not saved yet: try again.

name.invalid: The name needs at least one letter or digit.
name.taken: This name is already used. Choose another one.

description.empty: Say when this skill should be used.

address.url: Enter a full web address, starting with https://.
address.command: Separate the program and its arguments with spaces, without quotes.

blocked.saving: A save is running: try again in a moment.
blocked.invalid: The saved draft cannot be read as a system: fix it first.
blocked.unsaved: Save the draft first: it has changes that are not saved yet.

launch.intro: What the person who launches this system is asked or allowed to set. These are Macro settings: they follow each saved version and are not included in exports.
launch.unavailable: These settings are not available for this draft.

folderHelp.perExecution: Each run gets its own folder, created by Macro and available from Operate.
folderHelp.atLaunch: The person who launches chooses the folder. Macro warns them if another run already uses it.

launch.startMessageHelp: Turn it off if the system needs no message to start: the field then disappears from the launch window.
